title: Cozy Camper in the Country
description: Come enjoy the peace and quiet of the small town of Pegram, TN. Reconnect with nature in our comfy, cozy and clean camper. Just 30 minutes from downtown Nashville but far enough away to be able to rest, relax and rejuvenate. Our little camper is parked on the 13 acres where we live but has it’s own driveway and outdoor space so you will have peace and privacy during your stay. We provide fresh linens, towels, firewood and eggs from our chickens to all of our guests.

host_details:
We are a family of five who love hockey, the outdoors, exploring, and spending time on our land with our dog, cats, chickens, rabbit and lizards.
Hosting on Airbnb has been a part of our lives for over eleven years now. We love creating spaces for our guests to relax and recharge. 
In addition to being Airbnb hosts, Taylor is a firefighter and Star is a doula. Our sons play hockey and our daughter plays soccer. It’s a busy and fun life :)
